# Atlantic View

> Atlantic View is a 4-bedroom oceanfront beach house rental located at 511 Webhannet Drive, Wells, ME 04090, in the Moody neighborhood of Wells, Maine. The property sleeps 11 guests, offers panoramic ocean views from every floor, and is steps from Moody Beach and Wells Beach. Managed by Garnsey Bros.

## Property Details

- [About the Property](https://webhannet.vercel.app/en#about): 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom beach house with ocean views from every floor, wraparound deck, and updated kitchen
- [Photo Gallery](https://webhannet.vercel.app/en#gallery): 45 photos of the property interior, exterior, and views
- [Ocean Views](https://webhannet.vercel.app/en#views): Panoramic views from Moody Point to Ogunquit Beach, including Boon Island Lighthouse
- [Location & Map](https://webhannet.vercel.app/en#location): Interactive map with nearby beaches, restaurants, and attractions
- [Book a Stay](https://www.rentalprorentals.com/garnsey/ShowProp.cfm?propid=648): Reservations handled by Garnsey Bros — (207) 646-8301
